import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ===== 1. Pooled R² from exp_realcm_bias_identity.csv =====
df = pd.read_csv('results/exp_realcm_bias_identity.csv')
print('=== exp_realcm_bias_identity.csv ===')
print(f'Columns: {list(df.columns)}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Unique LLMs: {df[\"llm\"].unique()}')

pred = df['predicted_bias'].values
obs = df['observed_bias'].values
ss_res = np.sum((obs - pred) ** 2)
ss_tot = np.sum((obs - np.mean(obs)) ** 2)
r2_pooled = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
print(f'\nPooled R² (all 11 LLMs, all delta_tau): {r2_pooled:.6f}')

# Per-LLM R²
print('\nPer-LLM R²:')
for llm in df['llm'].unique():
    sub = df[df['llm'] == llm]
    p = sub['predicted_bias'].values
    o = sub['observed_bias'].values
    ss_r = np.sum((o - p) ** 2)
    ss_t = np.sum((o - np.mean(o)) ** 2)
    r2 = 1 - ss_r / ss_t
    print(f'  {llm:20s}: R² = {r2:.6f}')
